demo.strip: Demo — sample data, no messages are sent
demo.resetBody: This erases everything you created and restores the original sample requests.
demo.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

landing.title: Old land records, found for you
landing.pitch: Order old RTCs, mutation registers and land files from taluk archives. We search, scan and deliver them to your phone.
landing.step1Desc: Choose the service, village and survey number.
landing.step2Desc: A runner finds the old register at the taluk office and scans it.
landing.step3Desc: Download the watermarked PDF, or receive a printed copy.

track.title: Track your request
track.otpHint: Verify your mobile number to see every request placed with it.
track.noRequests: No requests found for this number yet.
track.notFoundTitle: We could not find that request
track.notFoundBody: Check the number and try again. It looks like KAR-2026-RTC-1001.
track.replyWhatsapp: In the live service you'd reply on WhatsApp
track.replyEmpty: Write a reply or attach a photo first
track.replySent: Reply sent. Your request is back under review.
track.downloadMissing: This file is no longer available in the demo
track.unavailableTitle: We could not find this record
track.unavailableBody: After searching the archive, this record was not found. The attached certificate explains the search that was done. You can download it below.
track.cancelledBody: No further work will be done on this request.

note.notFound: Not found in the taluk record room; an endorsement certificate is attached

OLD_RTC.name: Old RTC (Pahani)
OLD_RTC.desc: Past-year copies of the record of rights, tenancy and crops for a survey number.

OLD_MR.name: Old Mutation Register
OLD_MR.desc: The mutation entry showing how ownership changed hands.

LND_FILE.name: Land Grant File (Darkhast)
LND_FILE.desc: The original grant file, including the grant order and saguvali chit.

LRF_FILE.name: Land Reforms File
LRF_FILE.desc: Tenancy files such as Form 7, Form 7A and occupancy certificates.

RRT_FILE.name: RRT Dispute File
RRT_FILE.desc: Revenue Appellate Tribunal dispute files and orders.

templates.SURVEY_VILLAGE_MISMATCH: Survey number does not match the selected village register.
templates.MULTIPLE_ENTRIES_NEED_FATHER_NAME: Multiple entries found for this surname; please share the ancestor's father's name.
templates.RECORD_BRITTLE_SEARCH_ONGOING: Record volume is brittle or partly damaged at the taluk; search is ongoing.
templates.REQUEST_CLEARER_PHOTO: Please share a clearer photo of the old document you uploaded.

errors.yearOrder: The first year cannot be after the last year

storage.unavailable: Storage unavailable — changes won't survive a refresh

service.heading: Which record do you need?
service.hint: Pick one. You can place another request afterwards.

location.heading: Where is the land?
location.hint: Choose from the district down to the village. Each list narrows the next.

details.heading: Record details
details.hint: Fill in what you know. Fields marked * are needed.
details.surveyHint: Numbers only by default. Tap "Use letters" for values like 108/A or 2B.

upload.heading: Documents you already have
upload.hint: Optional. An old RTC, receipt or photo of the register helps the search. JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 10 MB each, up to 5 files.
upload.reattach: Please re-attach your files. They are not kept when the page is refreshed.
upload.choose: Choose files or take a photo
upload.rules: JPG, PNG or PDF. Up to 10 MB each. Up to 5 files.
upload.TYPE: Only JPG, PNG or PDF files are accepted
upload.SIZE: The file is larger than 10 MB
upload.COUNT: You can attach at most 5 files

delivery.heading: How should we deliver it?
delivery.hint: A digital copy is a watermarked PDF you can download from the tracking page.

DIGITAL.name: Digital copy
DIGITAL.desc: Download the PDF from your tracking page.

PHYSICAL.name: Printed copy
PHYSICAL.desc: We courier a printed copy to your address.

BOTH.name: Digital and printed
BOTH.desc: Download the PDF and also receive a printed copy.

delivery.emailHint: Optional. For your own records; no email is sent in the demo.

otp.wrong: That code is not correct. Try again.

verify.heading: Verify your phone
verify.hint: Enter your mobile number. We use it to find your requests later.

success.heading: Request received
success.subheading: Keep this number to track your request.
success.shareText: My land record request {number} is placed. Track it here: {url}

admin.gateBody: This is the back office. Choose a demo operator to continue. No password is needed in this demo.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Request no., survey no. or name
admin.empty: No requests in the queue yet.
admin.error: The queue could not be loaded.

ws.notFoundTitle: We could not find that request
ws.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the demo data was reset.
ws.loadError: The request could not be loaded.
ws.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

gallery.title: Customer uploads
gallery.empty: The customer did not upload any files.

status.title: Change status
status.note: Note on the timeline (customers do not see this)
status.closed: This request is closed. No further status changes.
status.confirmBody: Move this request to {status}? This closes the request and cannot be undone.

scan.title: Operator scans
scan.hint: Add the scanned pages in the order they should appear. JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 10 MB each.
scan.notAllowed: Scans can be added once the archive search has started.
scan.locked: The final PDF is saved, so the scans are locked.
scan.added: {count, plural, one {# scan added} other {# scans added}}

pdf.title: Final document
pdf.needScans: Add at least one scan to generate the PDF.
pdf.wrongStatus: The PDF can be generated once the archive search has started.
pdf.failed: The PDF could not be built. One of the files may be damaged or protected. Check the scans and try again.
pdf.tooLarge: The PDF is 10 MB or more, so it cannot be saved. Use fewer or smaller scans and generate again.
pdf.footerNote: The footer on every page is in English only, because the built-in PDF fonts cannot draw Kannada.

thread.title: WhatsApp thread
thread.bodyPlaceholder: Type a message to the customer
thread.closed: This request is closed. No more messages can be sent.
thread.simHint: Demo control. In the live service the customer replies on WhatsApp.
